topPRs.title: specs: Add L2 Contract Upgrades Specification (Part 1)
topPRs.author: maurelian
topPRs.body:
## Summary

This PR adds the first part of the L2 Contract Upgrades specification, converting the design doc into a formal spec that follows the established patterns in `specs/experimental/contracts/`.

## Components Specified

This PR includes specifications for the first 3 of 6 components:

1. ✅ **ConditionalDeployer** - Deterministic contract deployment with collision detection
2. ✅ **L2ProxyAdmin (Upgraded)** - Enhanced proxy admin with `upgradePredeploys()` capability  
3. ✅ **L2ContractsManager** - Configuration gathering and upgrade execution logic
4. ⏳ Network Upgrade Transaction (NUT) Bundle - Format, generation, and execution requirements
5. ⏳ Custom upgrade block gas limit - Mechanism for guaranteeing sufficient gas
6. ⏳ Upgrade Process - End-to-end upgrade flow and sequencing requirements

## Specification Structure

Each component includes:
- **Overview** - Purpose and role of the component
- **Definitions** - Key terms with cross-references
- **Assumptions** - External dependencies with mitigations
- **Invariants** - Critical properties that must hold, with severity ratings
- **Function Specification** - Detailed behavior using RFC 2119 keywords

## Next Steps

Remaining components (4-6) will be added in follow-up PRs to keep review scope manageable.

## Related

- [Design doc](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/blob/3074f0ee0e809ca12ae2358e76aed8f58d9a8c50/protocol/l2-contract-upgrades.md#L1)
